title: In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, a user that holds a role with the Assets edit or delete permission and access to…
description: Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0 contain a vulnerability where users with roles permitting asset editing or deletion and access to one or more tenants can modify or delete assets assigned to other tenants via the REST API. This occurs because the system verifies permissions but does not confirm tenant access for the target asset. Exploitation could lead to redirection of connector traffic, exposure of credentials and operational data, and disruption of integrations and data ingestion for other tenants.
